buildForTesting.description: Build reusable test products without running tests (default: false)

testProductsPath.description: Output path for the .xctestproducts bundle when buildForTesting is true

extraArgs.description: Additional xcodebuild/build-settings arguments (not app launch arguments)

launchArgs.description: Arguments passed to the launched app process on macOS runtime

progress.description: Show detailed test progress output (MCP defaults to true, CLI defaults to false)

testProductsPath.description: Path to a prepared .xctestproducts package. Cannot be combined with source inputs

testRunnerEnv.description: Environment variables to pass to the test runner (TEST_RUNNER_ prefix added automatically)

xctestrunPath.description: Path to a prepared .xctestrun file. Cannot be combined with source inputs

launchArgs.description: Arguments passed to the launched app process on macOS runtime

tools.description: Scans a directory (defaults to workspace root) to find Xcode project (.xcodeproj) and workspace (.xcworkspace) files. Use when project/workspace path is unknown.
tools.name: discover_projs

tools.description: Show per-target code coverage from an xcresult bundle.

showFiles.description: When true, include per-file coverage breakdown under each target

target.description: Filter results to a specific target name

tools.name: get_coverage_report

tools.description: Show function-level coverage and uncovered line ranges for a specific file.

file.description: Source file name or path to inspect

showLines.description: When true, include uncovered line ranges from the archive

tools.name: get_file_coverage

tools.description: Show current active defaults. Required before your first build/run/test call in a session — do not assume defaults are configured.
tools.name: session_show_defaults

tools.description: Switch the active session defaults profile.

global.description: Activate the global unnamed defaults profile.

profile.description: Activate a named session defaults profile (example: ios or watch).

tools.name: session_use_defaults_profile

tools.description: Set session defaults for the active profile, or for a specified profile and make it active.

bundleId.description: Default bundle ID for launch/stop/log tools when working on a single app.

configuration.description: Build configuration for Xcode and SwiftPM tools (e.g. 'Debug' or 'Release').

createIfNotExists.description: Create the named profile if it does not exist. Defaults to false.

derivedDataPath.description: Default DerivedData path for Xcode build/test/clean tools.

env.description: Default environment variables to pass to launched apps.

extraArgs.description: Default extra xcodebuild arguments for tools that accept extraArgs.

platform.description: Default device platform for device tools (e.g. iOS, watchOS).

preferXcodebuild.description: Prefer xcodebuild over incremental builds for Xcode build/test/clean tools.

profile.description: Set defaults for this named profile and make it active for the current session.

simulatorId.description: Machine-local simulator UDID, materialized from simulatorName when one is set; UDIDs are not portable across machines.

simulatorName.description: Canonical, machine-portable simulator selector (safe to share via SCM); the background refresh re-resolves it to this machine’s UDID.

simulatorPlatform.description: Cached platform derived from the selected simulator’s runtime; must be cleared/recomputed whenever the simulator selector changes.

tools.name: session_set_defaults

tools.description: Clear session defaults for the active profile or a specified profile.

all.description: Clear all defaults across global and named profiles. Cannot be combined with keys/profile.

profile.description: Clear defaults for this named profile instead of the active profile.

tools.name: session_clear_defaults
